description: ACEN stage-conformance (frozen packet-before-geometry capture): the golden `actionCenter.center` is the reference toolpipe's OWN published ActionCenter packet, read via a passive late-pipe probe during a live haul (zero drift confirmed across every recorded MOVE frame) -- not inferred from post-transform geometry.
source: Frozen from a task-0341 pipe-probe capture (packet-before-geometry: the golden is the reference pipeline's own published stage packet, read directly during a live haul via a passive probe -- not derived from post-transform geometry). No reference tool at test time.

provenance.notes: Packet-before-geometry: golden is the reference pipeline's OWN published stage packet, read directly during a live haul via a passive probe.

parameters.notes: Drive record read from the private capture harness. The case selects the polygon, activates the bare `move` tool, sets the action centre to selection mode, then performs one committed +50 px X-handle haul with the passive pipe probe active. The golden is the captured pipeline stage packet published during that haul, so the ACEN mode is the parameter under test and the drag is what made the pipe evaluate. `actr.select` is transcribed from this fixture's own `pipe_setup` and corroborated by `provenance.acen_mode`. The drag deltas are the harness spec's neutral keys; the cube segment count and gizmo handle scale in `setup` are stand.
